# RimLumen

> Native HDR VFX, programmable ShaderPacks, and GPU compute particle framework for RimWorld 1.7 (Waylith / Vulkan engine).

RimLumen adds an `RGBA16F` HDR pipeline, configurable `0-7` mip bloom, depth-aware soft particles (`R32SFloat`), GPU compute and native CPU particles, purely visual ground-pool point lights, and declarative multi-pass ShaderPacks.

## Map composition order

Effective render queues form four unmerged groups: `q < 3152` → 3152, `[3152,3169)` → 3169, `[3169,3178)` → 3178, `[3178,int.MaxValue)` → map end. Each boundary precedes same-queue vanilla grabs. Group 0 runs native HDR, early glow, bloom and the ShaderPack DAG / composite once before the 3152 Distortion grab, for routed HDR draws, early glow copies, distortion draws, direct HDR requests or runOnEmptyFrames. Direct RecordHdrDraws contributors must opt in via ILumenFrameContributor.RequiresDirectHdrPass (main thread, after capture; default false). Lifecycle and compute work alone do not request HDR. Pack `glow` contains only q < 3152 copies; `scene` and `depth` are same-frame 3152 snapshots. The ShaderPack UBO is 224 bytes; mapLightField retains its RGBA contract and `backbuffer` names the final output.

Later groups redraw additive glow copies and use host prefilter / down / up and an RGB-additive bloom-only composite preserving destination alpha, without tone mapping or re-adding cores. They reuse the captured active pack's BloomParams and requested mip count; absent groups or zero mips add no boundary or passes. No native HDR, pack DAG / history, grading or fog reruns. Custom bloom shaders apply only to group 0. Late Foggy bloom does not light mist or use fog-dependent scatter gain; pack composite colour mapping does not apply to late bloom.

Installed vanilla / DLC static inventory: ritual candles 3155 bloom at 3169 before weather fog 3169 and sun shadow 3170; orbital / power beams and endpoints 3177 bloom at 3178 after FogOfWar 3175 and before Gravship grab and Darkness 3180; grav-field 3181, engine 3185, thruster flame 3201 and Noctol eyes 4000 bloom at map end. No eligible inventory draws fall in 3169–3174 or 3178–3179. The map-end bloom is absent from the earlier 3201 Screen and 3251 VoidNode grabs; arbitrary overlay, grab and third-party ordering is not guaranteed. In-game behaviour has not been verified.

## Current ShaderPack input ABI

The UBO is 224-byte std140 at set 0 binding 5; 208-byte declarations remain valid but cannot refract their effect layer. Offsets: InvViewProjection 0 (mat4), ScreenAndMapSize 64 (vec4); floats GameSeconds 80, RealSeconds 84, SkyGlow 88, ZoomRootSize 92, HasHdrDraws 96, HasSceneDepth 100, HasMapLightField 104, IsPaused 108, DepthValid 112, GameDeltaSeconds 116, RealDeltaSeconds 120, ColorBlendSpace 124 (0 Legacy: hdr/bloom in stored units; 1 Linear: hdr/bloom in linear radiance, composite over the decoded scene and encode once); vec4 BloomParams 128, PackParams[4] at 144 (16-byte stride, row offsets 144/160/176/192, 64 bytes), and LayerFlags at 208 (x enables effect-layer refraction, y = 1 when the optional lightSum input holds the lighting-takeover light-pool sum and 0 when it is the black placeholder, zw reserved). Manifest target packParamN (N=0..15) maps to PackParams[N/4][N%4]; existing shaders must replace the old vector members with the array. Flags are independent 0/1 floats. Missing depth is reverse-Z far=0 with DepthValid=0; real boundary depth has DepthValid=1 (not a per-pixel geometry claim).

Particle DeltaTime and GameDeltaSeconds are actual TicksThisFrame/60, or zero when the host skips game update for LongEventHandler.ShouldWaitForEvent (Root_Play.Update AC:53551–53566); GameSeconds is TicksGame/60, stopping on pause. RealSeconds and RealDeltaSeconds are host elapsed/frame seconds. Vanilla speed requests are Normal 1, Fast 3, Superfast 6 (12 idle, 18 without maps), Ultrafast 15 (150 without maps, 20000 boosted), forced normal 1; completed ticks are budget-limited. Source: Verse.TickManager, Assembly-CSharp.decompiled.cs:52605–52646,52853–52888.

Default bloom threshold is 1.0 in settings and pack baseline; peak ≤ threshold extracts exactly 0. Knee=0 is a hard threshold without division by zero; positive knee uses excess*smoothstep(0,knee,excess) above threshold only.

mapLightField RGBA means Roofed / ArtificialGroundGlow / HasOutdoorTemperatureRoom / Fogged. R is RoofGrid.Roofed (AC:92166–92168), 255/0 as shipped. G is min(0.5,max(rgb)/255*3.6), rounded to UNorm8, excluding sky light (GlowGrid.GroundGlowAt artificial component, AC:69541–69542). B is 255 iff a Room exists AND Room.UsesOutdoorTemperature is true (AC:90349–90358), otherwise 0 including indoor-temperature Rooms and room-less walls/rock. This is a defined fact, not a placeholder or vanilla indoor/outdoor classification of room-less cells: TryGetDirectAirTemperatureForCell returns false/21f without a Room (AC:92707–92714), not that bool classification. No neighbour inference. A is FogGrid.IsFogged, 255/0 (AC:68695–68701). AC refers to Assembly-CSharp.decompiled.cs. Foggy reads roof R directly and combines it with B in its visual formula, enclosure=R*mix(1,0.55,B), leaving G strictly artificial light.

Turning vanilla glow enhancement off is pixel-identical only when no RimLumen effects are active and the active pack does not rewrite the scene.

## Documentation

- [English Developer API Manual](api.en.md): Complete reference for coordinates (`Vertical3D`, drawn as a true 60°-pitch orthographic view under the vanilla 2D camera / `GroundXZ`), `.lumen.json`, XML `LumenEffectDef`, the effect state machine (`states`, `stopState`, `Notify`), force fields, `RimLumenApi`, `LumenTextureRegistry`, `Chezhou.RimUnity` bridge, and the programmable `ShaderPacks` specification.
- [中文开发者 API 手册](api.md): Canonical Simplified Chinese developer manual (identical technical coverage; shipped in release packages at `docs/api.md`).
- [Project Overview & Build Commands](https://github.com/Neko-Yukari/RimLumen/blob/master/README.md): Bilingual modder/player feature overview and PowerShell build, test, and release packaging commands.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Neko-Yukari/RimLumen): Source repository for `RimLumen.Core`, `RimLumen.Adapter.RimUnity`, built-in `1.7/ShaderPacks/*`, and `1.7/Shaders/*`.

- **Modern VFX authoring**: [English sections 5.3–5.6](api.en.md#3-environment-forces-collision-and-sub-emitters) / [中文第五章第 3～6 节](api.md#3-环境力碰撞与子发射器): environment forces, collision, sub-emitters, per-particle `trails` (emitter-level Unity `TrailsModule` equivalent, pure-JSON/XML rising rocket + `Death` burst fireworks without C# `Follow`), distortion, ribbons, and screen dim. Environment pulse & cursor API: [English 6.6](api.en.md#6-environment-pulses-and-sustained-force--cursor-sources) / [中文第六章第 6 节](api.md#6-环境脉冲与持续力源--光标源). Screen distortion: [English 6.5](api.en.md#5-screen-distortion-and-third-party-writes) / [中文第六章第 5 节](api.md#5-屏幕扭曲与第三方写入).
- **Framework and adapter SPI**: [English chapter 10](api.en.md#10-framework-and-adapter-extension-spi) / [中文第十章](api.md#十框架与适配器扩展-spi): registry (`GetEnvironmentForces`, `GetCursors` with `Source`), `RegisterDrawAdapter` (process-lived private pass, main-thread `ILumenDrawAdapter.AdaptBinding`, null restores the map route, combined `ExcludedGlowLayerMask` skips vanilla glow copies), providers, service, frame contexts (`LumenCaptureContext.RendersMap`: `true` when rendering the map; when `false`, `CaptureMainThread` still runs to advance state/clocks while `EnqueuePreCompute` and recording are skipped, and contributors must advance state only without submitting draws or GPU staging), GPU and node-feature backends.

## Integration Surfaces

- **Effect coordinates**: The ground is the fixed world plane `Y = 0`. Every world position, including `LumenPlayRequest.OriginWorld` and `Follow` output, uses Y as height above ground in cells, never `Thing.DrawPos.y` or a RimWorld draw-altitude layer (pass `0f` for ground-anchored tracking; pass real height in cells only for elevated airborne origins). Node `LocalPosition` remains parent-relative. `WorldSpaceSimulation = false` moves/rotates live particles with `Follow` (evaluating local force fields and inverse-transforming environment forces/collision), whereas `true` leaves emitted particles in world space. `Vertical3D` projects height `h` to `0.5 × h` cells up the screen in vanilla 2D (60° pitch) and uses full height in 3D / IsoRim. Each Vertical3D node anchors at its own ground XZ; world-space particles retain the node's birth anchor, sub-emitter particles use the event point, and each ribbon sample uses its own XZ. `KillBelowFloor` expires descending particles only below world `Y = 0`.
- **Node depth mask**: `depthMask` / `LumenDepthMask.NorthBehindReference` uses `LumenPlayRequest.DepthReferenceZ` to test north-side particles and ribbons at the Projectile layer in vanilla 2D; see the [English node field notes](api.en.md#additional-field-notes) / [中文节点字段说明](api.md#字段补充说明).
- **XML `LumenEffectDef`**: Define `RimLumen.Core.Assets.LumenEffectDef` in `Defs/**/*.xml` with no C# dependency. Supports nodes, emitters (`sizeOverLifetime`, `colorOverLifetime`, `trails`, force fields, collision, sub-emitters), `distortion`, `ribbon`, `screenDim`, visual point lights (never written to `GlowGrid`; `overlightRadius` removed; overlapping pools sum linearly and the scene becomes `scene × (1 + C(ΣL))`, at most 2x; recommended `intensity` 0.5–1.2 for steady lamps and 1.0–2.0 for short bright flashes, do not copy vanilla `GlowGrid`'s 3.6 scale), `timelineEvents`, `interactionEvents`, and `states`. Entering any state intentionally restarts every node in that state (including `pointLight.intensityOverTime`, `distortion`, `screenDim`, and `ribbon` clocks), even if that node was already active in the previous state.
- **`.lumen.json` Data Assets**: Place `*.lumen.json` under `<ModRoot>/1.7/Data/RimLumen/` or `<ModRoot>/Data/RimLumen/`. Supports strict typo checking, `timelineEvents`, `interactionEvents` (`CursorEnter` / `CursorExit` / `CursorStay` / `CursorSwipe` with screen-height/real-second `minCursorSpeed` / `maxCursorSpeed` thresholds and lazy host mouse sampling, plus `Explosion` firing on shockwave-front arrival; connects directly to `goToState`, `targetNodeIndex` bursts, and `Notify` / `InteractionNotify`), named `states` (`duration` / `next` / `loop`, `initialState`, `stopState`), and `packageId:effectId` + first-writer-wins bare IDs. An explicit debug reload rebuilds the current JSON snapshot plus already-loaded XML Defs: fresh IDs replace same-named assets, including code registrations; stale scanner-owned keys are released, while unrelated code entries and later code overrides of stale keys survive. Playing instances stay unchanged, and XML files are never re-read. For imported RimUnity assets, calling `RimUnityAssetProvider.RegisterPackageRoot` again clears its catalogs and translated cache even when the path is unchanged.
- **Visual light pools (`pointLight`)**: visual only, never `GlowGrid`. Pools are occluded by a per-map occlusion map (4×4 texels per cell): `blockLight` things (walls, rock, doors by leaf gap) block over their occupied cells as infinitely high and light only their first layer; cover uses sprite alpha and transmits by `fillPercent`; roofs and off-map never block. Height-bearing non-blockLight things cast silhouette shadows from each point light and, under the takeover, from the sun (pack option `objectShadows`, default on) (light height H = node world Y, floored at 0; vanilla glowers H = 1). Each effect point light has an asset-only boolean `castShadows` (`"castShadows"` in JSON, `<castShadows>` in XML, `PointLightSpec.CastShadows` in C#; default `true`, no runtime API): `false` bypasses the occlusion map, generates no object shadow geometry, and takes no shadow mask channel even when global `objectShadows` is on; vanilla glowers and the takeover sun have no such field and are governed solely by global `objectShadows`. Optional setting `lightingTakeover` (default off, visual only, `GlowGrid` unchanged) replaces vanilla LightOverlay and sun shadows; off while IsoRim 3D view is ready; known incompatible with RimIris. See [chapter 7.4](api.en.md#4-light-pool-occlusion-and-lighting-takeover). Vanilla sun shadows inside a pool multiply by `(c+L)/(1+L)` instead of `c` (pixel-identical to vanilla outside pools); foreign shadow materials are left alone and logged once.
- **Gameplay light (`CompRimLumenLogicalLight`)**: ThingDef comp `<li Class="RimLumen.Core.Lighting.CompProperties_RimLumenLogicalLight"><glowRadius>6</glowRadius></li>` (finite, (0, 40] cells). Raises only `GlowGrid.GroundGlowAt` like a white non-overlit `CompGlower` (vanilla 8-neighbour flood, wall occlusion, 0.5 cap, Max with vanilla and other logical lights, vacuum = 0); never enters `GlowGrid`, so `VisualGlowAt`, the vanilla overlay and `mapLightField` G stay untouched. Lit under `CompGlower` rules (spawned, `FlickUtility.WantsToBeOn`, every `IThingGlower`), same comp signals; recomputed in `GlowGridUpdate_First`. Pair with a `pointLight` effect for the visible pool; do not add `CompGlower`.
- **C# Runtime (`RimLumenApi`)**: Target `net10.0`, reference `1.7/Assemblies/RimLumen.Core.dll` and game assemblies, and build with `<GameRoot>/Moddev/tools/dotnet/dotnet.exe` (system .NET 9 SDK fails with `NETSDK1045`). Call `RimLumenApi.Play` / `PlayAtCell` / `RegisterEffect` / `TryGetEffect` on the main thread; control playback via `ILumenEffectHandle` (`Trigger`, `GoTo`, `SetParam`, `SetLightIntensity`, `SetLightColor`, `Stop`, `Dispose`) and receive `Notify` / `InteractionNotify` (`LumenInteractionNotification` with `LumenCursorSource`: `HostMouse`, `ModCursor` + `ILumenEnvironmentSource`, or `None`) / `StateChanged` / `Finished`. `Map.Dispose` automatically disposes all native and RimUnity `External` handles on that map immediately (no fade-out) while preserving other maps. Inject explosion/radial pulses and sustained cursor/force leases via `EmitExplosion`, `EmitEnvironmentPulse`, `CreateMouseForce`, `CreateCursor`, and `CreateEnvironmentSource` (`ILumenEnvironmentSource`, auto-released on `Map.Dispose`).
- **Programmable `ShaderPacks`**: 3 built-in packs (`default`, `crisp`, `foggy`), plus `<ModRoot>/1.7/ShaderPacks/<Pack>/` or `Config/RimLumen/ShaderPacks/<Pack>/` (`pack.json` and GLSL `#version 450` fragment shaders). Missing or invalid saved `selectedShaderPackId` falls back to `default` with a `Log.Warning` naming the original id, and stale `objectShadowOverrides` keys are pruned. Declares custom intermediate targets (`R16G16B16A16SFloat`, `R8G8B8A8UNorm`, `R16SFloat`), persistent history (`prev:<name>`), `InvViewProjection` + Reverse-Z `depth` + 4-channel `mapLightField` + optional screen-space lightSum (RGBA16F per-pixel light-pool sum on lighting-takeover frames, LayerFlags.y; reserved source name) + bloom-only vanilla additive `glow`, custom bloom shaders, live `options[]` sliders, and isolated hot reload.
